object.description: Delete a committed file and commit with it selected; delete a file and stage the deletion in a git client, then commit the document; delete a whole document folder and commit; rename a document folder and its manifest and commit. Expected: each deleted file is absent from the new commit; after the rename the old folder is absent and the new one present; no uncommitted change is left in either folder.
